jobs.employer_name: thyssenkrupp AG
jobs.description:
Company

thyssenkrupp Forged Tech is a diversified supplier of components and system solutions for a wide range of different industries and markets. The forging group has a unique global footprint by operating around 50 forging presses and over 150 machining and assembly lines in 15 locations worldwide, including in Germany, Italy, the USA, Mexico, Brazil, India and China. With sales of well over 1 billion euro, the company specializes in the production of components and systems for the automotive, truck and construction machinery industries.

Your responsibilities

Are you passionate about driving business growth and building successful customer solutions in a global industrial environment?
At thyssenkrupp Forged Tech you will play a key role in expanding Berco’s Aftermarket business by shaping our product portfolio, supporting commercial activities and coordinating cross-functional initiatives in an international manufacturing network. Join us to contribute to profitable growth and create long-term value for our customers and business
You will

- Drive and support strategic growth initiatives for the global Aftermarket business while identifying opportunities and mitigating commercial risks.
- Coordinate Aftermarket activities across sales, operations, supply chain, finance and manufacturing sites to ensure effective business execution.
- Support commercial activities including pricing, quotations, delivery coordination and customer-related escalations.
- Optimize the Aftermarket product portfolio by supporting product introductions, standardization initiatives and profitability improvements.
- Contribute to business planning, demand forecasting and performance monitoring to support strategic decision-making.
- Collaborate with international stakeholders across the organization to drive sustainable and profitable business growth.

Your profile

You bring…

- A university degree in Business, Engineering or a comparable discipline.
- 5+ years of professional experience in Key Account Management, Sales or other commercial roles, preferably within an industrial or automotive environment.
- Strong commercial acumen and analytical skills with the ability to identify growth opportunities and drive business performance.
- Excellent communication, moderation and stakeholder management skills in an international and cross-functional environment.
- A structured and process-oriented mindset combined with a collaborative way of working.
- Fluent Business English and general willingness to travel internationally; additional Italian language skills are considered an advantage.

Your benefits

- Extensive development opportunities through global talent management and tailored qualification programs.
- Flexible work arrangements, including the option to work remotely up to 2 days per week for a better work-life balance.
- Competitive compensation package under the collective agreement of the metal and electrical industry NRW, including 30 days of vacation, additional special leave (e.g., for relocation or marriage), vacation pay, and other tarif specific payments.
- Excellent company pension scheme (“Kombipakt”) – a modern, employer-subsidized plan with attractive interest rates.
- Modern, open workspace in a central location in Essen with a healthy and varied subsidized canteen.
- Convenient accessibility, with very good public transport connections and free parking facilities.
- Attractive employee discounts for gym memberships, car purchases, and online shopping.
- Health and wellness programs, including regular preventive check-ups, flu vaccinations, and skin cancer screenings through our in-house medical service.
- Job bike leasing for sustainable mobility.

Contact

Tobias Mäurer
People und Culture Specialist
tobias.maeurer@thyssenkrupp.com

We value diversity

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity.
We look forward to receiving your meaningful and complete online application, stating your desired salary and earliest possible starting date.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tasks & responsibilities

- In this role, you will leverage your extensive legal expertise to mitigate launch risks from third party patents for our newly developed products as well as to enforce and defend our patents to defend our products against patent infringement.
- With a strategic mindset, you will develop complex launch risk mitigation strategies in a cross functional set up and provide tailored advice to the business how to leverage upside potential from our existing patent portfolios.
- Managing and instructing our network of external lawyers and patent attorneys in disputes including in-court infringement and nullity proceedings will be a key part of your responsibilities.
- In addition, you will support the negotiation and drafting of complex agreements to find the best possible solutions for Boehringer Ingelheim.

Requirements

- Fully qualified lawyer, preferably with honors in the second state examination. An additional qualification (LL.M. or comparable degree with a focus on IP law) is desirable
- Longterm specialization in the field of intellectual property and the pharmaceutical industry at an international level as well as extensive experience in managing large international IP portfolios
- Longterm relevant professional experience in external law firms specialized on patent litigation or in a comparable in-house position as a corporate counsel
- Experience in leading, coordinating, and managing patent litigation
- Knowledge and experience in the pharmaceutical industry
- Strong strategic understanding and the ability to quickly grasp and clearly present legally and technically complex matters
- High level of teamwork and excellent communication skills in English and German

What we offer

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.employer_name: Blissair GmbH
jobs.description:
BLISSAIR, based in Bocholt, Germany, is an aviation company, providing customized air transport solutions and aviation services.

BLISSAIR stands for safe, fast, and comfortable private air travel worldwide, delivered through our own aircraft fleet as well as an extensive network of partner aircraft.

Our facilities in Bocholt have recently been expanded to include a CAE Full-Flight Simulator for the King Air B200 equipped with a Pro Line 21 cockpit. A second simulator is already in the planning stage.

The simulator provides a highly realistic representation of the aircraft and is certified to the highest qualification standard, Level D. This gives BLISSAIR a unique market position, as it is the only simulator of its kind in Europe.

To support the ongoing maintenance and operation of this simulator, we are looking for an enthusiastic aviation-minded team player to join us as soon as possible.

Your Profile

- Completed vocational training as an Aircraft Electronics Technician, Electronics Technician, Mechatronics Technician, a comparable technical qualification, or a degree in an engineering or technical field.
- Good computer skills, particularly with Windows operating systems and older computer hardware
- Good IT skills, basic network setup and understanding of network protocols.
- Familiarity with technologies such as RS-232, Ethernet, Fibre Optics and Microcontrollers.
- Ability to repair and replace hardware components, perform soldering and rework, troubleshoot and diagnose electrical and electronic faults, trace wiring and signal paths, measure and test electrical circuits using diagnostic equipment, interpret electrical schematics, and carry out component-level repairs
- Ability to work independently with a high level of personal responsibility.
- Knowledge of C++ programming language and experience in the aviation industry are an advantage.
- Fluent in spoken and written english
- Quick learner with strong teamwork skills, initiative, and enthusiasm.
- Strong interest in technical systems and aviation industry

Your Responsibilities

- Work as part of the simulator maintenance team.
- Independently perform maintenance and servicing of simulator hardware, including quality checks.
- Provide technical support during customer training operations.
- Analyze and diagnose faults, carry out repairs.
- Document maintenance activities, inspections, and quality checks.

What We Offer

- A friendly working environment in a small team with an open, collaborative culture and flat hierarchies.
- A responsible and varied role with exciting technical challenges.
- The opportunity to work on a unique Level D King Air B200 simulator—the only one of its kind in Europe.
- A positive workplace atmosphere and modern facilities.
- The chance to contribute to internal process improvements and help plan and implement the company's second simulator.

Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Elektrotechnik, Betriebssystem Windows XP, Betriebssystem Windows Server 2003

Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, sorting and distributing - BEUMER Group develops and produces technically leading intralogistics systems for the global market. We do our utmost to promote this claim: within the framework of a family-like cooperation characterized by high mutual esteem and a culture of trust that creates stability and security. Our common goal: to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

- Designing and implementing ServiceNow CSM and ITSM capabilities across core modules

jobs.description:
The Friedrich Schiller University Jena is a dynamic and innovation-driven university centrally located in Germany. With a broad range of disciplines, it shapes the future through excellent research and teaching. Its scientific excellence is reflected in the profile areas Light - Life - Liberty, which provide pioneering insights and sustainable solutions for the society of tomorrow. Through close collaborations with leading research institutions, innovative companies, and renowned cultural organizations, it advances interdisciplinary developments. With around 17,000 students and approximately 10,000 employees, it defines Jena as a vibrant, internationally connected city of science and innovation.

The Institute of Biodiversity, Ecology and Evolution at the Faculty of Biological Sciences seeks to fill the position of a

Doctoral Researcher in Viral Ecology (m/f/d)

commencing on 01 December 2026. We offer a part-time position (65%, 26 hours per week), with a fixed-term employment until 30 June 2030.

The DFG-funded Collaborative Research Centre 1768 “VirusREvolution: Decoding tools for virus research” is a highly ambitious research centre at Friedrich Schiller University with the joint goal to develop novel tools for virus discovery, characterisation, regulation, interaction, and visualisation (https://virusrevolution.uni-jena.de/). Its integrated research training group is educating doctoral researchers in a structured, interdisciplinary training program and invites applications for doctoral and postdoctoral researcher positions in various fields of research.
In this doctoral project “Do viruses exploit their quasispecies for host range evolution?”, you will investigate how host range and environmental conditions shape virus diversity and virus-host interactions in natural and experimentally manipulated microbial communities.
Conduct experimental work and analyses on virus-host interactions in soil and groundwater ecosystems, including host-range assays, environmental sampling, and targeted microcosm experiments
Analyse metagenomic and viromic data sets from soil and groundwater samples to identify broad- and narrow-host-range viruses to characterize their quasispecies characteristics
Participation in the Collaborative Research Centre VirusREvolution and close collaboration with the tandem project partner
Engage in regular discussions with other group and project members
Collaborate with BSc and MSc students working in associated projects
Publish papers and present your work at national and international scientific meetings

A highly motivated candidate with a Master of Science or equivalent degree in biology, microbiology, microbial ecology, virology, bioinformatics, or a related discipline
Experience in experimental microbiology, microbial ecology, and molecular biological methods; knowledge of sequencing-based bioinformatic approaches (metagenomics, viromics); experience with virus-host interactions are desirable.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving
Ability to work independently and in a collaborative team
Excellent skills in English are required, both written and spoken

Embedding in a cross-disciplinary, experienced research group and a large, ambitious research consortium
Affiliation to an Integrated Research Training Group, offering close support and a comprehensive education program for hard skills and transferable skills, supported by the Jena Graduate Academy
A family-friendly working environment with a variety of offers for families
University health promotion and a wide range of university sports activities
Remuneration based on the provisions of the Collective Agreement for the Public Sector of the Federal States (TV-L) up to salary scale E13 - depending on the candidate’s personal qualifications -, including a special annual payment in accordance with the collective agreement.

jobs.description:
As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You define and own the product security strategy for our global portfolio and establish the policy framework for secure development, security baselines, and release criteria.

You drive CRA readiness across the entire portfolio - from product classification to conformity assessment, and the build-out of SBOM and evidence processes.

You shape the governance for our AI-driven security remediation (agentic OpenCode pipeline) - including guardrails, approval criteria, and quality assurance.

You build the Security Guild and a network of Security Champions embedded in the FIRE teams, and foster lived security practice through training and coaching

Several years of experience in product security, application security, or as a deputy CISO within a complex, multi-product software organisation.

Demonstrable, current expertise in the EU Cyber Resilience Act - requirements, classification logic, and conformity assessment-along with working knowledge of NIS2 and GDPR.

Strong, practical knowledge of the secure development lifecycle, threat modelling, and application security testing, together with hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, and SonarQube tooling.

Experience with SBOM generation and governance, as well as with managing supply chain risk; understanding of AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to enforce standards without direct line authority; CISSP or an equivalent certification is an advantage.

Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

jobs.employer_name: Universitätsklinikum Leipzig Anstalt öffentlichen Rechts
jobs.description:
The Medical Faculty of Leipzig University, with its tradition spanning more than 600 years, is one of the largest research institutions in the Leipzig region. With over 1,300 employees, it is the largest of the university's 14 faculties and serves as a training center for approximately 3,500 students in human medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, and midwifery.

We are seeking a highly motivated Epidemiologist to design and conduct epidemiological research in pediatric populations, focusing on the determinants of child health, the development of common childhood diseases, particularly obesity, and the prevention and long-term outcomes of childhood obesity and metabolic diseases.
The research group "Childhood Obesity and Metabolic Research", led by Antje Körner, investigates the development, mechanisms and health consequences of childhood obesity. The translational approach combines experimental research, clinical studies and genetic approaches. Our international and interdisciplinary team is closely integrated with the research structures of the Medical Faculty of Leipzig University, Helmholtz Munich, and leading local as well as national research consortia, such as the Excellence cluster LeiCeM, the German Center for Child and Youth Health (DZKJ), and our large children's and adolescents' cohort LIFE Child.
We have large, well-characterized cohorts up and running with a longitudinal setting and across the entire age range: LIFE Child (n~6000), Leipzig Obesity Childhood Cohort (n~2500), and Leipzig Adipose Tissue Childhood cohort (n~700), with deep phenotyping allowing for combining clinical, epidemiological, lifestyle and functional omics and multi-omics data.
Key Responsibilities

- Design, plan, and conduct epidemiological research projects, including cohort and intervention studies.
- Develop study protocols and statistical analysis plans.
- Analyze and interpret complex population-based, clinical, and/or health-related datasets.
- Preparation of scientific manuscripts, reports, presentations, and grant applications.
- Ensure high standards of data quality, reproducibility, and compliance with ethical and data protection regulations.
- Present research findings at national and international conferences and scientific meetings.
- Provide methodological expertise and consultation to ongoing research projects; collaborate closely with clinicians, statisticians, bioinformaticians, and other researchers
- Supervision junior researchers or students.

Required Qualifications
Education: Candidates should have a Ph.D. and/or M.D. degree in: Epidemiology, Public Health, Biostatistics, Medicine, Health Sciences or a related discipline.
Professional Experience

- Experience in the design and implementation of epidemiological studies, large cohort studies.
- Experience working with large-scale health, clinical, or population-based datasets.
- Strong understanding of epidemiological study designs and methodologies.
- Experience with observational and interventional research.
- Experience in data cleaning, validation, and quality assurance.
- Familiarity with evidence-based medicine and public health principles.
- Track record of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals is desirable.
- Experience in interdisciplinary and collaborative research environments.
- Knowledge of research ethics and data protection requirements.
- Experience in grant writing is an advantage.
- Knowledge of causal inference methods (e.g., Target Trial Emulation, Mendelian Randomization) is desirable.

Statistical and Analytical Skills

- Proficiency in at least one statistical programming language such as: R, SAS, Stata, Python.
- Experience with general statistical methods:
- Regression modeling
- Longitudinal data analysis
- Missing data methods
- Sensitivity analyses
- Knowledge of modern analytical approaches, including machine learning methods, is an advantage.

Personal Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent organizational and project management abilities.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.
- Communication skills: English - excellent; German - very good

Candidates with one or more of the following areas of expertise are particularly encouraged to apply:

- Cohort studies
- Precision medicine and risk prediction modeling
- Multi-omics, biomarker, or biobank data integration
- Obesity, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, or metabolic health research
